name: Mekaurobal
backstory: Child of Mekobaluk and Mekaurelo; raised in Gorff on takes stonework commissions at the market each morning,..., and carries some knowledge of Death Of Darnus 2.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only by making Death Of Niemius their own concern
criterion.wasted_life: treating Death Of Niemius as someone else's concern
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: takes stonework commissions at the market each morning, still building her own name apart from either side of the family

arc.premise: As the newest generation at the market stall, Mekaurobal wants to be the one who finally gets the roof raised - lining up her own first material pledges before she's even fully out from under her parents' names.
